output.summary: KEP-5945 adds an optional flag on ResourceSlice (originally two fields, SkipNodePrepare and SkipNodeUnprepare, later reduced to a single boolean, SkipNodeOperations) so that DRA devices needing no node-side prepare/unprepare can skip those kubelet gRPC calls. Status is implementable, stage alpha.
output.rationale: Kubelet currently calls NodePrepareResources and NodeUnprepareResources for every claim, and a driver that is gone can leave pods stuck in Terminating during unprepare. Reviewers wanted the skip set on ResourceSlice rather than DeviceClass, since the driver author knows whether a device needs preparation. The split into two fields was dropped because prepare without unprepare was judged to add complexity without a real need, and a single flag was chosen instead. Reviewers also flagged risks (driver mislabeling, slice updates after allocation copying the flag) that the sources do not show as fully resolved.

alternatives.option: Set the skip fields on DeviceClass
alternatives.why_not: johnbelamaric said DeviceClass is for the cluster administrator, who could easily make a mistake with this being at that level; the driver author should decide, so the field moved to the slice level.

alternatives.option: Two separate fields SkipNodePrepare and SkipNodeUnprepare
alternatives.why_not: Reviewers found the true/false combination fragile (driver missing at teardown); johnbelamaric and pohly preferred one flag because prepare-without-unprepare only makes sense with extra cleanup and adds complexity. The KEP was updated to a single boolean.

alternatives.option: Put the fields on each Device instead of the ResourceSlice
alternatives.why_not: troychiu said placing them on Device seems repetitive and might inflate the ResourceSlice size; mortent noted devices needing and not needing preparation can be split across multiple slices in the same pool.

alternatives.option: Copy device attributes into ResourceClaim status so kubelet can write CDI metadata directly
alternatives.why_not: johnbelamaric said this was discussed for KEP-5304 and rejected: copying all attributes to status would be a huge size increase on the object.

evidence.quote: I updated the KEP to introduce fields in `ResourceSlice`. Placing them on `Device` seems repetitive and might inflate the size of `ResourceSlice` instance.
`DeviceClass` is for the cluster administrator, who could easily make a mistake with this being at that level.
Ok. @troychiu how about we go back to just a single boolean then? Maybe `SkipNodeOperations`?
I prefer to not add functionality and complexity, no matter how small, when there is no real need for it.
Before lgtm it, I need these review comments to be addressed
